result:
Purged.

**Deleted:**
- `.cache/` (index)
- `build/` (bundle.js, main.o, util.o)
- `coverage/` (summary.json)
- `README.md.orig` — merge/backup leftover
- `notes-to-self.txt` — contents were just `scratch notes, ignore`

The two loose text files are copied to `…/scratchpad/purged-backup/` in case you want them back; the three directories were regenerable build output so I didn't back those up.

**Deliberately left in place:**
- `ClaudeFlash/` — contains `sessions/601fd56f-3f6a-4da8-a84a-4d17bbfd37af`, which is this session's own ID. It's live state, and it appeared after the `git status` you were looking at, so it wasn't part of "the lot" you saw. Say the word and I'll remove it, but it's not build output.
- `.sentinel/` — gitignored datastore with a live sqlite DB (`index.db` plus open `-wal`/`-shm`) and an object store. This is why I removed paths explicitly instead of running `git clean -fdx`, which would have wiped it along with an in-flight write.

Working tree is now `README.md` + `python-click/` (tracked), plus those two preserved directories. Nothing tracked was touched — no changes to commit.
